sentences.en: If she gets some antibiotics and sleeps, she'll get better.
sentences.zh: 如果她吃点抗生素好好休息，就会好起来。

sentences.en: Antibiotics were discovered at the beginning of the twentieth century.
sentences.zh: 抗生素是在二十世纪初被发现的。

sentences.en: Many people don't realize that antibiotics are ineffective against viruses.
sentences.zh: 很多人不知道抗生素对病毒无效。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：anti（抗）+bio（生命）+tic →抗生素
